_comments: A progress observation's amounts are magnitudes on every line, a reversal (negative-quantity) line
included, while the line's own RecognizedToDate carries the line's sign so it nets against the origin
(#803). Orders.RecordProgress computes the catch-up on magnitudes and a supersede reverses the replaced
row's RecognitionAmount as stored, so signing the row would change that arithmetic. The descriptions
say so. AutoUpdateDescription is off so CodeGen does not restore the extended-property text.

fields.Description: Revenue recognised on the line before this observation posted, as a magnitude: positive on a reversal (negative-quantity) line too, where the line's own RecognizedToDate is negative. Materialised for the audit chain; agrees with the size of the sum of posted recognition entries for the line.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Fields.Entity=MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Line Progress Measurements&Name=RecognizedToDateBefore

fields.Description: Revenue recognised on the line after this observation posted, as a magnitude: |LineTotalNet| × PercentComplete, rounded to the cent. Positive on a reversal (negative-quantity) line too, where the line's own RecognizedToDate is negative. At 100% it is the line amount's size exactly.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Fields.Entity=MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Line Progress Measurements&Name=RecognizedToDateAfter

fields.Description: The delta this observation posted: After − Before, on magnitudes. NEGATIVE on a backward slide (the entry is mirrored, Dr Sales / Cr Deferred Revenue), whatever the line's sign; on a reversal line the entry itself carries the line's sign. Zero when the observation moved nothing, in which case no entry was written.
